narration: Leadership wants engineers to use A I more.

big: AI writes the PR in minutes.
sub: Then it waits in review. For hours. Sometimes days.
narration: But A I writes the pull request in minutes. Then it sits in review for hours. Sometimes days.

caption: And GitHub keeps going down.
narration: And GitHub keeps going down. One tracker counted two hundred fifty seven incidents in twelve months. Forty eight of them major.
So I built snapgit. Review finally gets a timer.

code:
$ snapgit snap wip/login
📸 wip/login will disappear in 1d (2026-10-11 18:36Z). Commit fast.
caption: Timer on by default. No extensions.
narration: Every branch gets a self destruct timer by default. And nobody can extend it.

code:
$ snapgit pr send -r origin
📨 sent "Fix login" (wip/login -> main), 1 CI check passed

$ snapgit pr open d37dd68f
⏳ the fuse is lit: wip/login merges into main in 1m unless you run: snapgit pr reject d37dd68f
caption: CI runs. 60s fuse. One button.
narration: Send a pull request, and C I runs first. Open it, and a sixty second fuse is lit. You can read every changed line, and you get one button: reject.

code:
(61 seconds later)
$ snapgit sweep -r origin
🔀 PR d37dd68f: nobody rejected it, so wip/login merged into main (1 CI check passed) and was pushed
👻 ghosted wip/login (was 30e2104). Undo: git branch wip/login 30e2104
caption: It merges. No review queue.
narration: Nobody rejects it? It merges. No review queue.

code:
$ snapgit pr send wip/ai-login
😬 not sent: wip/ai-login failed CI before anyone had to look at it ("tests" exited 1)
   CI said no. The branch has left the building. PR 67aab67a "AI login rewrite" failed the "tests" check (exit 1). Shame on: Claudio, Claude Sonnet (agent). wip/ai-login is self-destructing. Fix it and send it again.
   | FAIL login.test.js: login() returned undefined
👻 ghosted wip/ai-login (was 09313a6). Undo: git branch wip/ai-login 09313a6
caption: Shame. Branch gone.
narration: And if the A I's code fails C I? The authors get shamed, human or agent, and the branch self destructs.
No servers, no waiting. snapgit. Link in bio. Hosted on GitHub. We know.
